description: Create a new uptime monitor. Supports HTTP status checks, keyword matching, regex matching, content change detection, and content staleness alerts (Pro+). Set type to 'heartbeat' for cron job / background task monitoring, or 'tcp' (Pro+) to check that a host:port accepts connections — TCP checks can target bare IP addresses, which HTTP checks cannot.

checkInterval.description: Heartbeat type: expected seconds between pings, from the plan minimum (60 on Pro+) up to 604800 (7 days). Other types: ignored, set automatically from the plan

expectedStatusCode.description: Expected HTTP status code (default 200, http type only)

failureThreshold.description: Number of regions that must fail before alerting (0 = alert on any failure, multi-region only)

gracePeriod.description: Heartbeat type only: extra seconds a ping may be late before the monitor is down (default: the interval, capped at 3600)

headers.description: Custom request headers as JSON string, e.g. '{"Authorization": "Bearer token"}' (http type only)

host.description: Hostname or IP address to connect to (tcp type only)

keyword.description: Value depends on keywordMatchType: keyword text for contains/not_contains, regex pattern for regex_match/regex_not_match, number of days for content_stale, unused for content_changed (Pro+)

maintenanceEnd.description: Maintenance window end as ISO datetime string (Pro plan+)

maintenanceStart.description: Maintenance window start as ISO datetime string (Pro plan+)

method.description: HTTP method (default GET, http type only)

port.description: TCP port to connect to (tcp type only; port 25 is not supported)

regions.description: Comma-separated region IDs for multi-region checks: us-east, us-west, eu-west, eu-central, ap-southeast (Team plan+, http type only)

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (1-120, default 30, http type only)

type.description: Monitor type: 'http' checks a URL, 'heartbeat' waits for pings from your application, 'tcp' opens a connection to host:port (Pro+)

url.description: URL to monitor (required for http type, ignored for other types)

name: create_monitor
